protocol.population: Unchanged Fix05 known-client as-of eligible frames; no total-click cap or future-outcome filtering.
protocol.replay: Four fits of unchanged LR settings recover the original predictions. Require exact prediction hashes for LR, prior CTR and pooled CTR excess.
protocol.models: No new candidate, tuning or Random-Forest fit. All eight original Fix05 results remain retained.
protocol.tie_policy: Stable descending scores in original canonical client/content order.
protocol.pair_bound: Let d be known-positive A-only minus B-only. Bounds on P50(A)-P50(B) are (d-unknown_B_only)/50 and (d+unknown_A_only)/50.
protocol.overlap: Shared pages, including shared unknown outcomes, cancel exactly in a paired difference.
protocol.client_influence: Delete each eligible client once, rerank fixed predictions on remaining pages at the same K. Do not refit after deletion.
limitations: Missing-data bounds apply to these finite queues under the frozen tie policy; they are not confidence intervals.
Client deletion measures evaluation-portfolio sensitivity, not uncertainty of training or unseen-client model performance.
Repeated clients/pages and only two later periods limit generalization. No iid tests or bootstrap confidence intervals.
Diagnostic comparisons are exploratory, not a new blind confirmation or a change of the primary prediction task.
Counterfactual missing labels may have additional unmodeled constraints; reported bounds allow any binary labels for exclusive unknowns.
No warehouse query or June access.
